heroHeadline: mRNA Skin Cancer Vaccine Shown to Slash Recurrence Risk, Advancing Personalized Cancer Immunotherapy
heroSubtitle: On May 21, the FDA announced a rare advisory committee hearing for June 18 to evaluate Moderna's mRNA-1010 flu vaccine — the first mRNA flu vaccine application under US review — sending MRNA stock down 5.5% ahead of an August 5 PDUFA decision. On May 22, BioNTech announced ASCO 2026 presentations featuring pumitamig NSCLC Phase 2/3 data and six-year follow-up from the autogene cevumeran pancreatic cancer mRNA vaccine trial, in which ~87.5% of immune responders remain alive. A May 13 Nature Biotechnology study from MIT and Harvard described an mRNA-encoded adjuvant (IRF8 + NIK) that eradicated most tumors in mice and amplified T-cell responses 10–15×, raising prospects for next-generation cancer vaccine formulations.
footerNote: Data sourced from FDA, EMA, WHO, NIH, peer-reviewed publications (NEJM, Nature Biotechnology), BioNTech and Moderna investor reports, and ASCO/AACR 2026 presentations. Timeline covers 2020-12-11 to present.
